confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge; no live listings or city price pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderate confidence. Accommodation is lower confidence because July falls in Brazil's winter school holidays and rates vary by booking channel and included taxes and fees. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against beer (about 2x) because direct bar and by-the-glass knowledge is weaker. The FX value comes from web search results attributing it to the RBA table for 2026-10-16; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. The regional basis is Brazil's Atlantic coastal tourism market. Accommodation reflects visitor districts in the Zona Sul (Copacabana, Ipanema, Leblon, Botafogo), and dining and drink levels were cross-checked against other large Latin American tourist cities.
